<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for up to 40 nitride compositions, limiting to 3 polymorphs each and energy above hull ≤0.3 eV. We'll use the batch tool to fetch all at once, saving into the provided WORKDIR. After retrieval, we’ll list the generated JSON files, build a mapping from composition to its file path, and then consolidate them into a single JSON dataset. Finally we’ll output the path to the consolidated file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "Li3N", "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "Si3N4", "BN", "TiN", "ZrN", "HfN", "VN",
        "NbN", "TaN", "CrN", "MoN", "WN", "Fe3N", "Co3N", "Ni3N", "Cu3N", "Ag3N",
        "PtN", "PdN", "ReN", "OsN", "IrN", "ScN", "YN", "LaN", "CeN", "PrN",
        "NdN", "SmN", "EuN", "GdN", "TbN", "DyN", "HoN", "ErN", "TmN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_5"
}
</action_input>
